The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya. I'm going by memory here, not a checked source. The note's other option, B.P. Koirala, doesn't fit, because he became prime minister but, as far as I know, never served as mayor of Kathmandu. My earlier answer, Padma Ratna Tuladhar, was probably someone from a later period.

CONFIDENCE: 72
